run_video_classification_inference: run video classification inference on one or more video files using a VideoMAE model on HPU
run_video_classification_with_bf16: run video classification inference with bfloat16 precision for faster HPU performance
run_video_classification_with_hpu_graphs: run video classification inference wrapped in HPU graphs for lower latency
run_video_classification_with_warmup: run video classification inference with warmup epochs to get accurate timing measurements
run_video_classification_from_url: run video classification inference on videos downloaded from HTTP URLs
